culprit_citations.quoted_text: Total investments, at fair value (amortized cost $ 607,574 and $ 695,240 , respectively) | 578,649 | 642,213
The Company and STRS Ohio are the members of STRS JV, a joint venture formed as a Delaware limited liability company that is not consolidated by either member for financial reporting purposes.

findings.detail: The extracted holdings sum includes separate STRS JV look-through schedule investments even though the filing states STRS JV is not consolidated; the parent schedule total is 578.649 million, not 932.947 million.

rationale: Class 3 aggregate GAV reconciliation. The raw filing anchors total investments at fair value to 578,649 thousand in both the consolidated statement and the consolidated schedule total. The extracted position sum is 932,947,000, exceeding that source anchor by 354,298,000. The filing separately presents STRS JV portfolio investments totaling 323,552 thousand and states STRS JV is not consolidated by either member, so treating JV look-through holdings as parent holdings creates over-coverage rather than a valid reconciliation scope.
